hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has an entry for Mixed Great Andamanese [gac], the Koiné formed by the last speakers of the Great Andamanese varities. But Mixed Great Andamanese cannot be asserted to be unintelligible with its source varieties, in particular Aka-Jeru [akj] (**hh:g:Abbi:Great-Andamanese**).
See also: Aka-Jeru [akj].
